I need to think about shirt colors based on liking shades of red. Since he likes red, maroon, and burgundy, crimson would be a fitting choice. Crimson. He seems to favor red tones (red, maroon, burgundy), and crimson fits that palette. If you think he wants variety instead, white is the safest versatile alternative; blue if you want a contrasting color.
